proposition: The treatise sent to Shāhrukh with letter 20 was most probably the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk, written for Bāysunghur in 829/1426, which contains the prediction that the Shahrukhid state would last a century.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: MK writes 'most probably'; the letter names no title
